rigs: Original local MuJoCo xArm7 and independently exported native left/right XHand models; arm configuration fixed.
objects: Original assets from reports/three_page_refinement_20261028/zoo-native-sources; constrained shapes reuse existing static website geometry.
motion: Native constrained FK where available. Other object keypoint deformations are illustrative transport of existing mesh surfaces, not fresh neural inference.
optimization: Offline native-hand MuJoCo contact replays for 15 tuned hand/object combinations; compound object collision geometry and object-specific geometric/contact loss. Website playback does not run learned AWR inference. Native xArm follows wrist by IK; arm dynamics are not evaluated.
gradient_diagram_source: worldstring-plus/grasp_opt/common/ws_direct_grasp_loss.py and solvers.py; both fields frozen while preserving input gradients.
catalogue: 50 examples: 30 rigid/articulated, 7 skinned, 13 soft; original photographs/material renders cropped from paper/figures/assets.png. Per-object image provenance: assets/zoo-thumbnails/sources.json.
sharpa: Five independently optimized native Sharpa Wave contact replays; thumb/index-only cup-handle pinch. Native joint limits, collision shapes, anatomical collision exclusions and mass/inertia; bounded position servos and frictional soft-finger contacts. Object remains a gravity-driven free body. Offline simulation, not hardware or live neural-field execution.
